title: Cannon--Thurston maps for Anosov foliations
summary: Universal circles, introduced by Thurston and Calegari--Dunfield, are not well understood in general. Recently, the author together with Taylor showed that Anosov foliations with branching admit nonconjugate universal circles. We continue the study of these universal circles and show that for an Anosov foliation with branching on a hyperbolic manifold, the leftmost universal circle admits a Cannon--Thurston-type map to the ideal 2-sphere.
